dedupe_keys.name: arcep togo quarterly electronic communications market observatory 2018 to 2026

description: ARCEP Togo publishes a quarterly observatory of the electronic communications markets. The page lists 34 files from the first quarter of 2018 to the second quarter of 2026, first as sector evolution notes, then as dashboards (tableaux de bord) and now as the market observatory. The 18-page edition for the second quarter of 2026 gives subscriber numbers, traffic, turnover and investment for the fixed and mobile markets. The mobile market has two operators, YAS Togo (formerly Togo Cellulaire) and Moov Africa Togo; the fixed market is served by the incumbent and internet providers. Coverage: Togo, national totals by quarter and operator. Format and access: PDF reports on the ARCEP website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the layout changed several times; the files are PDFs, so tables must be extracted; operator splits may be limited by confidentiality. Simulation uses: quarterly demand, traffic and investment series for Togolese telecom capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives annual national series; data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell locations for Togo.
